cut: In crates/domain/src/heavy.rs, partition the filtered waiters directly, sort the passed-over entries in place, and compute elapsed time since opening in Window::open_for so since_from can go. In crates/domain/src/heavy.rs and crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs, carry queue::Order through Begin with serde defaults instead of splitting and rebuilding it. In crates/domain/src/doctor.rs, reuse one resource snapshot across all holders and one oldest lookup across both stall messages. In crates/host/src/clock.rs, make UTC the default Clock::offset_min implementation and delete the identical ManualClock implementation.
answer: Made all four (25d408a): resources partitions the filtered waiters and sorts the passed-over in place; Window::open_for computes the time since opening in ms and since_from is gone; Begin carries queue::Order (serde default) and StartHeavy reads it as is; doctor builds one resources snapshot for all holders and one oldest lookup for both stall messages; Clock::offset_min defaults to UTC and ManualClock no longer repeats it. Also moved the never-run #286 unit tests out of the domain (test = false) into scenarios/order.rs.
